name: Hiroki Tanaka
bio:
Hiroki Tanaka's journey in motorsport began with a childhood obsession with Formula One, fueled by late-night races broadcast from Europe. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Tokyo, he quickly immersed himself in the world of racing, starting as a junior engineer for a Super GT team. His meticulous attention to detail and innovative problem-solving skills caught the eye of senior management, leading to a swift ascent through the ranks.

Tanaka is a firm believer in data-driven decision-making, combined with fostering a culture of open communication and collaboration within his team. He views the team principal role as not just a manager, but a facilitator, empowering each member to contribute their best work. His distinctive approach involves integrating cutting-edge simulation technologies with real-world track data to optimize car setup and race strategy, always seeking a competitive edge through innovation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Hiroki is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing tailored suits.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing circuit diagrams and notes.
Insists on a daily morning meeting to discuss team goals and progress.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his desk when deep in thought.
